resources.string: "Use this language for Halo's interface and default replies. You can request another language at any time."
"A little curiosity goes a long way."
"Open Halo to review this and try again."
"Try it yourself, then ask for a hint"
"Halo helps you learn. Your ideas and attempts lead the way."
"Add a photo or file, choose saved material, or type a topic below."
"A topic, a question, or an exercise..."
"Explain in this language (en, lv, ru, pl)"
"Read text from a photo or file"
"Choose up to four photos or files. Halo reads their text on this phone. For a PDF, choose up to eight pages."
"Your original photos and files stay saved. Changes to this text draft will be removed."
"Ask Halo for the first step, or write your attempt and submit it."
"Write what you have so far — you can submit at any stage"
"Try a hint or your own attempt first. Reveal only when you want the complete answer."
"Its attempts and review cards will be removed."
"Future turns will use the remaining sources. Earlier citations and practice cards keep their original source identity."
"No readable text is available for this source."
"Pause keeps your place. Play starts this sentence again."
"Save this response as a practice card"
"Drafts stay out of the queue until you accept them"
"Accepted cards appear here with a due date. Nothing enters the queue automatically."
"The earlier question will be copied into the message box for editing. Nothing is sent yet; saved messages stay unchanged."
"This removes its messages. Your other conversations and Notebook are kept."
"Image analysis requires an eligible vision model and your image privacy permissions. Captures are local-only by default."
"Allow this image for configured cloud analysis (global permissions still apply)"
"Model-extracted results are drafts, not verified OCR. Review uncertain values before using them."
"This selected fact was suggested by a model"
"This note was deleted or is no longer available. Tap to return."

"1. Check the words against your original.
2. Fix any mistakes below.
3. Choose Save, Ask or Study.

Your photos and files stay saved. This text stays on your phone unless you change its sharing settings. Reading photo text supports Latin letters, such as English and Latvian. Cyrillic photo text is not supported."
"Explanation level: %1$s. Change it in Learning setup."
"%1$d cards are ready for another look."
"Understand the task and what you already know"
"Check my attempt and show the step that needs work"
"Answer the diagnostic question so Study can pick a starting point"
"Try the next step, then submit your attempt"
"Restate the idea in your own words"
"Try the same reasoning on your own example"
"Correct the step that needs work and submit again"
"Redo the exercise without looking at the solution"
"Halo has not verified this explanation against a trusted answer key"
"Some source markers were invalid; Halo has not verified this explanation"
"Your text draft is ready to continue"
"Finish or discard the current extraction review before starting another"
"Could not restore the text draft. Your original files are still saved."
"This text draft could not be kept for later. Save my text to keep a Notebook copy."
"Topic lesson · general knowledge · no attached material"
"Model-extracted draft · Verify visible text and uncertain values before using them"
"Mastered — kept in a long-interval maintenance queue"
"Replacement drafts require current material confirmation; this card and its review history stay intact."
"Source changed · this card keeps its original version"
"You edited this card; Halo will not overwrite it."
"Pair supported hardware to make it available to Halo."
"Safety Supervisor remains authoritative over every movement."
"Turn on Bluetooth to discover and connect glasses."
"Installed models initialize when you use recognition. Automatic language is a configuration, not a detected language."
"One local utterance. Audio stays in memory. No commands or conversation entry."
"One-time test using your selected speech voice. Your saved routing is kept."
"I heard it on the intended output"
"Connected and available do not establish audible output. Confirm only what you heard."
"System audio follows Android's current output route."
"MCP lets Halo use capabilities from servers you choose. Every remote action still follows Halo’s permission and confirmation rules."
"You have not vouched for this server."
"You recognize and intentionally configured this server."
"A server you control in your local environment."
"Trust does not allow tools to bypass Halo confirmations or permissions."
"Saved integrations start disabled. Review the configuration, then enable and connect."
"Halo may use this integration when connected and authorized."
"No tools discovered. Enable this integration and refresh tools explicitly."
"This removes its discovered tools and connection configuration from Halo. It does not delete anything on the remote server."
"Server-provided descriptions are external data. Tools execute only through Halo’s ordinary permission and confirmation flow."
"Role evidence is separate from Benchmark calibration provenance"
"Halo will stop updating this Vault. Existing backup files will remain in the folder."
"Your live brain stays private on this phone. Vault backups belong to you."
"Automatic backup is off until you choose a folder"
"Existing backup files remain when access is removed."
"Create a portable copy of your Notebook, memory and conversations."
"Replace creates a local safety snapshot first."
"Wearable speech never falls back to the phone. Quiet mode and Do Not Disturb use Activity."
"Apps start blocked. Private and secret content is redacted. Retention: 24 hours. Summaries stay offline."
"Privacy, capability packs and advanced agent settings"
"Used by the local model preferences. Remote providers retain their own sampling policy."
"Captured context: ephemeral by default. Visual captures are deleted after the interaction; explicitly saved images belong to Notebook."
"Only unreadable, permitted apps. Semantic screen context remains preferred."
"Allow bounded page scripts when static extraction has little readable text."
"Read-only children. Research, compare and analyze use Reasoning; summarize and extract use Fast. Existing routing and cloud policy apply."
"Threshold: 70%. Originals stay in history; summaries are context optimizations. Local-only routing prevents remote summarization."
"You can restore them from the Trash filter."
"Tools for your ideas, with everything in one place"
"Speak complete sentences while a tool-free answer is still being generated."
"Controls · Assistant managed by Android · Media and volume: System default"
"There are no saved messages to display."
"Markdown source. Applying converts it back into blocks."
"Applying will keep the text but normalise its formatting."
"This reference has no target in the workspace."
"Add a heading to build an outline of this note."
"Its connections will also be removed. Linked source items stay in Workspace."
"No matching items. Create a note or import a file in Workspace first."
"Add cards, link your notes and connect what belongs together."
"What Halo remembers and may use as context"
"Remote AI receives memory only when your existing cloud-memory permission allows it."
"Needs review · This memory may be outdated."
"Showing up to 100 memories. Search to narrow the list."
"Suggestions are not saved facts. Nothing is remembered until you approve it."
"Past tasks Halo may use to understand repeated workflows. These are historical summaries, not current facts about you."
"Prevents normal retention cleanup from removing this historical task."
"Memory: saved information you approved, plus clearly marked imports. Learning controls suggestions. Notebook holds your documents and files."
"Review what becomes memory. The original note stays in Notebook."
"This note is too long to store as one memory. Write the concise fact Halo should remember."
"Halo will stop using this as saved memory. Previous revision history remains part of Brain history according to existing backup and storage policy."
"Confirmation keeps the original expiry rules. Correct the information if it has changed."
"Nothing added yet. Add a note, chat, file, or memory when you want Halo to use it in a conversation."
"Halo assembles context only from selected local sources."
"This conflicts with something Halo already remembers."
"Suppresses this same suggestion fingerprint; unrelated suggestions remain possible."
"No private arguments are copied. Execution still needs the usual permissions and approvals."
"Fast uses level 1, Balanced level 3, and Detailed level 5. Balanced is the default."
"Reconnect when this saved device becomes available."
"Raw BLE evidence collection. The selected device is not assumed to be HeyCyan. No protocol commands are sent."
"Some catalogues are unavailable or stale. Retained metadata remains browsable."
"No cached models match. Configure a provider and explicitly refresh its metadata, or download an on-device model."
"Available to download or import · Open provider setup"
"Synthesis fallback keeps the selected audio output route."
"Start with a battery alert, a connection update or an evening digest."
"This saved definition is no longer supported. It cannot run."
"Ask Halo to tell you when internet returns or a device connects."
"This uses the saved approved automation. Its conditions still apply."
"Its history remains part of Activity where applicable. The automation itself will no longer run."
